verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official scriptable CLI, nitropy, which a runtime probe confirmed installs keylessly from PyPI, plus a Python SDK on PyPI. A community report also describes using a Nitrokey HSM on a code-signing server via OpenSC, which points to unattended server-side automation. Nothing documents headless or CI workflows, and as a physical device it needs attached hardware; touch confirmation may also require a human present. Missing for 10: documented headless/CI usage guidance, non-interactive operation docs (PIN/touch handling in automation), independent hands-on CI corroboration.
